items.title: Season kickoff: what I'm changing this year
items.summary: New season means new structure — heavier sled work, longer threshold runs, less junk volume.
items.take: Last year I trained tired. This year I train on purpose — if a session doesn't move a number, it's out.

items.title: Doubles is the fastest-growing division
items.summary: Pairs entries are up again this season — and the standards are rising with them.
items.take: 59:40 isn't bragging, it's homework — Sam and I logged every split to get there. Find your person early.

items.title: Race-day fuelling, minus the influencer nonsense
items.summary: What actually works on race morning: carbs early, nothing new, and a plan for the last four stations.
items.take: If your fuelling plan needs a spreadsheet tab and a prayer, it's not a plan. Boring food, boring wins.
